label: accepted

evidence.V1: Pointed-heater shield outline reads instantly in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view is a thin rim bar but still reads as a badge edge-on; outline is mirror-clean and A15 error is 0.0 on X and Y.
evidence.V2: Clear three tiers: thick gold rim plate (big), recessed teal field (medium), raised cream diamond emblem (small); each separated by a stepped depth change.
evidence.V3: Chunky rim and soft bevels are stylised, but the diamond emblem is undersized (about a quarter of field width) and a thin flat slab on a flat field, so the face reads plain and primitive rather than exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Uniform rounded chamfers on rim, field and emblem edges catch a consistent highlight in both close-ups; no razor or blobby edges.
evidence.V5: Studio and flat close-ups show no patches, pinches, seams or z-fighting; rounded rim corners show a few gentle facet steps in flat light only; A17/A18 pass, 0 flipped faces, 0 cap overlaps.
evidence.V6: Gold accent, one teal hue in two values plus cream emblem; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the field hue, value contrast stays strong.
evidence.V7: 404 tris against a small-class target of 600 (ceiling 1500).
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/cream palette, ~0.045-stud style chamfers and smooth shading match the PASS anchor badge closely.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CanCollide off for decor, CollisionFidelity Box, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).

artifacts: minor facet steps on the rounded rim corners visible in flat light (low corner segment count)
top_fixes: Enlarge the emblem (roughly 35-40% of field width) and give it a bevelled/raised centre facet or inner inset so the face has a stronger focal read
Add a subtle secondary detail (inner bevel line or small studs on the rim) to push stylisation beyond a flat extruded plate
Add one or two segments to the rim corner rounds to remove the faint faceting in flat light
